The region $D$ in the plane is enclosed between two circles centered at $O$ of radii $1$ and $3$, as shown above. What is
$$
\displaystyle ∬_(D)(1 - x^{2} - y^{2})dA
$$
expressed in polar coordinates?
corrected_content.worked_solution:
The annulus has $1\le r\le3$ and $0\le\theta\le2\pi$. Multiplication by the polar Jacobian gives $(1-r^2)r$, so use
$$\int_0^{2\pi}\int_1^3r(1-r^2)\,dr\,d\theta.$$
